1. Jotirao Phule (III): Critiqued Brahminical purity-pollution dogmas and founded the Satyashodhak Samaj in 1873.
2. E.V. Ramasami Periyar (I): Founded the Dravidian Self-Respect Movement, promoting atheism and anti-caste rationalism.
3. Sri Narayana Guru (II): Consecrated egalitarian temples with the motto 'One Caste, One Religion, One God for All Men'.
